module: Yaw control supervisor (modern ESC, type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 60) of the drivingDynamics architecture. At every fixed step it asks the first yawProvider that answers (e.g. STMEstimate) for the expected yaw, compares it to the measured yaw (sensorHub.yawAVSmooth), computes the difference and the front/rear slip angles, then calls actAsYawControl of each registered component (brakeControl, motorTorqueControl, awdControl...). It drives the electrics.values.esc/escActive light.
usage:
local yc = controller.getControllerSafe('drivingDynamics/supervisors/yawControl')
if yc then yc.setParameters({isEnabled = false}) end
notes: Signature called on each component: actAsYawControl(measuredYaw, expectedYaw, yawDifferenceAdjusted, bodySlipAngleAdjusted, frontSlipAngle, rearSlipAngle, dt); must return true if the component intervened.
Yaw providers must expose calculateExpectedYaw(speed, dt) (returns nil if they cannot answer) and setParameters. Yaw is in rad/s, slip angles in rad, speed in m/s.

If the measured yaw and the expected yaw have opposite signs (countersteering), the expected yaw is inverted. yawDifferenceRaw = (measured - expected) * sign(measured): positive = oversteer, negative = understeer.

bodySlipAngleAdjusted = body slip angle * confidence coefficient (linearScale 0.5..0.8 of trustWorthiness.bodySlipAngle) * low-speed coefficient (goes to zero below 8..10 m/s). The front/rear angles are only computed if the speed used exceeds 1 m/s, otherwise 0.
The light is smoothed; electrics.values.esc stays at a steady 1 if isEnabled is false. Unlike tractionControl, shutdown also sets updateFixedStep to nil.
init replaces controlParameters with {isEnabled = true}. No jbeam key is read in this file (the supervisor does not use jbeamData).
Components are sorted by componentOrderYawControl (or order), providers by providerOrder (or order).

isActive.desc: True after init, false after shutdown.

isActing.desc: True when the yaw control intervenes continuously (smoothed flag >= 1).

init.desc: Resets parameters, providers and components and sets isActive to true.

initSecondStage.desc: Sets electrics.values.hasESC to true and saves the initial parameters.

initLastStage.desc: Sorts providers and components by their order.

updateFixedStep.desc: Fixed step: computes the expected yaw, the difference, the slip angles, then calls the components.

updateGFX.desc: Updates electrics.values.esc and escActive from the smoothed state (replaced by a version with a debug packet if setDebugMode(true)).

setDebugMode.desc: Enables/disables sending debug packets (yaw differences, slip angles, speed used) to the CMU.

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU (virtualSensors, vehicleData, sensorHub, sendDebugPacket, applyParameter, warningLightPulse).

shutdown.desc: Disables the supervisor (isActive=false, updateGFX, update and updateFixedStep set to nil).

setParameters.desc: Changes isEnabled via CMU.applyParameter; propagated to the providers (key "isEnabled") and to the components (key "yawControl.isEnabled").

setConfig.desc: Replaces the configuration and propagates isEnabled.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU ("config" debug packet).
